description: A 3HP multimode filter of the Moog ladder kind, with low pass, high pass and band pass responses

params.text: A three-position switch choosing the response: low pass, high pass or band pass
Sets the cutoff frequency, from about 20Hz at 0% to about 20kHz at 100%
Adds resonance around the cutoff, from none at one end of its travel to close to self-oscillation at the other
Trims the level of the filtered signal, -25dB to +25dB, with no change at the centre

inputs.text: The voltage here divided by 10 scales the cutoff setting, 10V leaving the cutoff where the knob puts it and 0V dropping it to about 8Hz
The voltage here divided by 10 scales the resonance set by reso, 10V leaving it where the knob puts it and 0V removing it
